ui.disclaimer: Decision aid for education and team discussion. It is not an order. Clinical judgment and local protocol take priority.

buttons.resetConfirm: Changing the setting clears all answers. Continue?
buttons.startOverConfirm: Confirm reset: clear all answers and start over?

screens.title: The gate
screens.prompt: Check each item that is true right now.

items.label: Quantitative train-of-four ratio is 0.9 or higher (adductor pollicis)

screens.title: Airway risk
screens.prompt: Check every item that applies. Leave all unchecked if none apply.

items.label: Known or suspected difficult intubation or mask ventilation
Restricted airway access (head or neck surgery, halo, wired jaw, cervical fixation)
Airway edema, hematoma, or changed anatomy
Aspiration risk (full stomach, delayed gastric emptying)

screens.title: Surgical priority
screens.prompt: Would coughing at extubation harm the surgical repair (for example intracranial, eye, some ENT or plastic surgery)?

fields.label: Which device and plan (videolaryngoscope, bougie, supraglottic airway)?
Where is the front-of-neck access kit?
Where will the patient go, and who will watch them?

screens.title: Readiness screen
screens.prompt: Check each item that is true today.

items.label: The cause of respiratory failure is improving
PaO2/FiO2 is 150 or higher on PEEP of 8 or less and FiO2 of 0.5 or less
Hemodynamically stable (no vasopressor or a low dose)
Breathing on their own with sedation minimized

screens.title: Spontaneous breathing trial
screens.prompt: Did the patient pass a 30 to 120 minute trial on pressure support of 5 to 8 cmH2O (or T-piece)?
screens.info: Stop the trial for any of: respiratory rate above 35; SpO2 below 90%; heart rate above 140 or a sustained change of more than 20%; systolic pressure above 180 or below 90; agitation, sweating, or rising work of breathing.

screens.title: Airway protection
screens.prompt: Check each item that is true.

items.label: Secretions manageable (suctioned 2 times or fewer in the last 8 hours)
Follows commands or protects their airway

screens.title: Stridor risk
screens.prompt: Check every item that applies. Leave all unchecked if none apply.

items.label: Large endotracheal tube for the airway

screens.title: Cuff-leak test
screens.prompt: Result of the cuff-leak test. A failed test is a leak below 110 mL or below 12 to 24% of the delivered tidal volume.

screens.title: Reintubation risk
screens.prompt: Check every item that applies. Leave all unchecked if none apply.

items.label: Difficult or prolonged weaning (failed the first trial)
Heart failure was the main reason for ventilation
Airway patency problems (high risk of laryngeal edema)

screens.note: Any one factor counts as high risk in the Hernández 2016 trials. Most ICU patients qualify, so the count is shown with the result.

fields.label: Which device and plan (videolaryngoscope, bougie, supraglottic airway)?
Where is the front-of-neck access kit?
Where will the patient go, and who will watch them?

flowRules: Screens run in the order listed in flow for the chosen track.
A screen with showIf is skipped when its condition is false. Skipped screens still count toward the step number.
After a screen with stopIf, if the condition is true, go straight to the result with that outcome. Later screens are not shown.
checklist screens never require a box to be checked. yes_no, single_choice, and text_fields screens marked required cannot advance until answered (text fields: non-empty after trimming).

Back returns to the previous shown screen and keeps its answers. Back on the result returns to the last screen shown; after a stop outcome, that is the screen whose stopIf fired. Choosing a different setting asks resetConfirm (buttons confirm and cancel) and then clears every answer.
The setting screen (step 0) has no top bar: no track title, no step label, and no reset button.
Start over (buttons.reset) asks startOverConfirm (buttons confirm and cancel); on confirm, it clears every answer and returns to the setting screen.

OR_STOP_GATE.title: Do not extubate yet
OR_STOP_GATE.text: Correct each unmet hard item, then reassess.

OR_AT_RISK.title: Awake extubation only
OR_AT_RISK.text: Extubate awake. Consider an airway exchange catheter, exchange to a supraglottic airway, a remifentanil infusion, or postponing extubation.

OR_LOW_DEEP_OPTION.title: Awake by default; deep is an option
OR_LOW_DEEP_OPTION.text: Extubate awake by default. Deep extubation is acceptable here only with an easy airway, no aspiration risk, and a clinician ready to rescue the airway.

fixed: Coughing would harm the surgical repair

ICU_STOP_NOT_READY.title: Not ready for a breathing trial
ICU_STOP_NOT_READY.text: Do not start a spontaneous breathing trial today. Continue daily sedation interruption and reassess tomorrow.

ICU_STOP_SBT_FAILED.title: Do not extubate
ICU_STOP_SBT_FAILED.text: Return to rest ventilator settings, look for the reversible cause, and reassess in 24 hours.

ICU_LOW_RISK.title: Extubate to high-flow nasal cannula
ICU_LOW_RISK.text: Extubate to high-flow nasal cannula for 24 hours. In low-risk patients it reduced reintubation compared with conventional oxygen (4.9% vs 12.2%).

fixed: Passed readiness screen and breathing trial

ICU_HIGH_RISK.title: Extubate to preventive support
ICU_HIGH_RISK.text: Extubate to preventive noninvasive ventilation (ATS/ACCP 2017) or high-flow nasal cannula (noninferior to NIV for reintubation, 22.8% vs 19.1%). If the patient tolerates it, high-flow alternating with NIV reduced day-7 reintubation compared with high-flow alone (11.8% vs 18.2%).

outcomeRulesNote: Evaluated top to bottom for the track; the first match wins. Only used when no stopIf fired.

ALERT_OR_SOFT_GATE.text: Not yet optimized: {items}. Correct if possible before extubation.

ALERT_ICU_AIRWAY.text: Passed the trial, but airway protection is uncertain: {items}. Discuss before extubation.

ALERT_CUFF_FAILED.text: Cuff-leak test failed. Give systemic steroids at least 4 hours before extubation (for example methylprednisolone 20 mg IV 12 hours before, then every 4 hours). A repeat leak test is not required.

ALERT_CUFF_NOT_DONE.text: This patient has stridor risk factors. A cuff-leak test is recommended before extubation.

ALERT_POSTEXT_FAILURE.text: If respiratory failure develops after extubation, do not use NIV as rescue. Reintubate without delay.

alertRules: Show alerts only when the result is not a stop outcome (onStop false).
Order on screen and card: red alerts first, then amber, each group in the order listed here.

An alert with requiresAck is shown on its screen when its condition becomes true; Next stays disabled until the acknowledge checkbox is checked. The acknowledgment stays while the alert's item list stays the same or gets shorter; if a new item appears, the checkbox clears and Next is disabled again. On the result, the alert appears with its acknowledge checkbox, which is informational and blocks nothing.
resultLayout: rescuePlan (if answered; each answer under its field label)
evidence (collapsed; full citations for outcome and alert sources, deduplicated, in order of first appearance)
cardLayout: header: app name, ui.card.header, track title, local date and time
rescuePlan (each answer under its field label)
references: short source labels, then full citations
layoutRules: Result and card sections have no headings. The only section label is buttons.evidence, on the collapsed evidence section of the result.
